changes: First release: Chris Johnson's Airwindows Mackity, a Mackie-style desk input stage, on FX1 or FX2 of any track.
TRIM drives the desk from silence through 0 dB at 13 to +39.6 dB into its clip; PAD sets the output level.
Upstream's algorithm is unchanged; Modwerk ported it to the Octatrack's DSP.
Known issue: not yet tested on a unit.
